row.trigger_text: Autonomous monitor: purchases by 5 different customers through one rare device profile, all scored as fraud by the transaction model (total $500.00) on card C11309-K1. Investigate transaction 3497738 and related activity.

evidence.claim: The transaction model trained on the bank's own closed cases (4,665 confirmed-fraud and 900 cleared investigations, July-October; October hold-out AUC 0.973) scores this transaction 0.832, against a 2.1% base rate. It reads the unnamed Vesta C/D/M/V columns, the identity record, running aggregates of the resolved account and the graph's memory of earlier closed cases, all as known at transaction time (it never sees the case outcome)

This card has 1 earlier alert(s) that were cleared as false alarms (CC-0023; latest note: "Case CC-0023: model scored a $24.91 transaction at 0.94. Cardholder confirmed travel to the billing region in question. Alert cleared.")

Case memory: similar closed cases retrieved by graph-filtered vector search and account lineage: CC-2406 (confirmed_fraud, card_not_present_fraud); CC-1005 (confirmed_fraud, card_not_present_fraud); CC-3996 (confirmed_fraud, card_not_present_fraud); CC-5452 (confirmed_fraud, card_not_present_fraud)

case.summary: The alert was triggered by an autonomous monitor detecting purchases by five different customers through a single rare device profile, including a $100.06 online transaction on card C11309-K1. The transaction model scored this activity at 0.832, and during step-up authentication, the cardholder denied making the purchase. Consequently, the verdict is card-not-present fraud. The final actions are to block the card and create a case.
